prompt_md: A gambler bets he'll roll at least one six in four rolls of a fair die. What's his chance of winning?
prompt_short: At least one six in four rolls of a die?
hint_md: Find the chance of no six at all.
explain_intuition_md: Adding one in six four times gives 4 in 6, but that double-counts the games with more than one six. It's easier to find the chance of no six at all: a bit under 50%. So the gambler wins just under 52% of the time, barely better than even.
